# A 100.00 USD invoice booked at 1.405 CAD/USD — 140.50 CAD of revenue — with
# 45.00 USD of it settled into a CAD bank for 62.00 CAD.
#
# The USD settled cost 45 x 1.405 = 63.225 CAD exactly: a half-cent. Money
# rounds away from zero, so that is 63.23 CAD, and the loss realized is
# 63.23 - 62.00 = 1.23 CAD.
#
# What this fixture produces, visible in the exported payment transaction:
#
#   value: "-63.23"              what the 45.00 USD cost
#   Income:FX Gain 1.23 CAD      the loss realized on settling it
#
# Python's `round` is banker's rounding and sends an exact half to the nearest
# even cent — 63.22, and a 1.22 loss. One cent, in the books and in the gain
# reported for the year, on a figure a filer has to stand behind. This is why
# the arithmetic is handed to GnuCash rather than done in Python.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_half_cent_rounding.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-HALFCENT"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-HALFCENT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 45
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 62.00
		memo: "Part payment for INV-USD-HALFCENT"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
